headline: GoTyme Targets South Africa Retail Banking Leadership by 2036
summary: GoTyme became Africa's first profitable standalone digital bank this year with 13 million clients and aims to reach 30 million clients by 2036, targeting the top retail-banking spot.
why: Growth targets and profitability milestones in digital banking signal shifting consumer trends and increased competition in emerging financial markets.

impacts.name: Retail Banking
impacts.why: Aggressive expansion by digital banks alters competitive dynamics in the traditional banking sector.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
